category.title: Wellbeing & Fitness
category.description: Private, browser-local planning and reflection tools for everyday movement, rest, and wellbeing routines. Outputs are estimates and prompts, not medical advice.

tools.title: Sleep Window Planner
tools.description: Builds a practical bedtime and wind-down window from a desired wake time, sleep target, and typical time to fall asleep.
tools.limitations: This is a scheduling estimate, not a sleep assessment; individual sleep needs and sleep quality vary.

tools.title: Hydration Rhythm Planner
tools.description: Distributes a user-entered daily beverage target across waking hours and produces simple checkpoint times.
tools.limitations: It does not determine an appropriate fluid intake; heat, activity, medications, and health conditions may change personal needs.

tools.title: Walking Break Scheduler
tools.description: Turns a work or study block into recurring short walking-break times while preserving a final wrap-up buffer.
tools.limitations: Times are reminders to adapt, not a prescription; accessibility, duties, and fatigue should guide actual breaks.

tools.title: Workout Interval Builder
tools.description: Creates a repeatable work-and-recovery interval session from round count and durations, including total session time.
tools.limitations: Intervals are generic planning math, not individualized exercise instruction; stop if movement feels unsafe or painful.

tools.title: Stretch Session Builder
tools.description: Allocates a short mobility session across a chosen focus using gentle, time-boxed segments.
tools.limitations: This is a timing template, not flexibility treatment or a diagnosis; use comfortable ranges and seek qualified care for persistent pain.

tools.title: Breathing Session Timer
tools.description: Converts a chosen inhale, hold, exhale pattern into cycle timing and a complete session plan.
tools.limitations: Breath holds are optional; stop if dizzy or uncomfortable and do not use this as treatment for a breathing condition.

tools.title: Habit Streak Recovery Planner
tools.description: Builds a low-pressure recovery plan after missed routine days, using a restart size and a short review horizon.
tools.limitations: A planning aid only; it cannot account for mental health, disability, or life circumstances and should not be used for self-judgment.

tools.title: Mood & Energy Check-In
tools.description: Combines three self-entered 1–5 ratings into a transparent snapshot and a small next-step prompt.
tools.limitations: A reflection aid, not a mental-health screening or diagnosis; contact appropriate support if you feel unsafe or overwhelmed.

tools.title: Training & Rest-Day Balancer
tools.description: Checks a planned week of training and rest against a user-set preferred rhythm and highlights the remaining balance.
tools.limitations: It does not assess readiness, injury risk, or recovery needs; use personal experience and professional guidance where relevant.

tools.title: Weekly Movement Mix Planner
tools.description: Allocates a weekly minute budget across cardio, strength, mobility, and enjoyable movement according to entered percentages.
tools.limitations: Percentages describe a personal plan, not a universal guideline; the tool does not prescribe intensity or exercises.

tools.title: Step Goal Ramp Planner
tools.description: Creates a gradual multi-week step target ramp from a current average, desired target, and weekly increase cap.
tools.limitations: Step counts are optional planning targets, not health requirements; adjust for comfort, access, and professional advice.

tools.title: Distance Pace Converter
tools.description: Calculates average pace and speed from a manually entered distance, elapsed time, and unit system.
tools.limitations: Average pace does not capture terrain, conditions, or effort; this is not performance or medical advice.

tools.title: Run-Walk Interval Calculator
tools.description: Estimates total session duration and distance for repeating run and walk segments at user-entered speeds.
tools.limitations: Speed estimates are user assumptions and actual distance will vary; it is not a training prescription.

tools.title: Strength Rep-Volume Log
tools.description: Totals sets, repetitions, and load volume for one movement so a local training log is easier to review.
tools.limitations: Volume is only one training metric and does not indicate safety, quality, or appropriate load.

tools.title: Flexibility Progress Tracker
tools.description: Compares two user-entered range or reach measurements and reports absolute and percentage change without interpreting ability.
tools.limitations: Measurements depend on method and conditions; consistent technique matters, and change is not a diagnosis or treatment outcome.

tools.title: Meditation Session Plan
tools.description: Breaks a chosen quiet-practice session into settling, main practice, and closing segments with optional repeats.
tools.limitations: This is a time structure, not therapy or treatment; stop or adapt if the practice increases distress.

tools.title: Screen Break Planner
tools.description: Creates a sequence of screen-free microbreaks and one longer reset across a manually entered screen block.
tools.limitations: Breaks may need to change for work, school, caregiving, or accessibility; this is a planning aid only.

tools.title: Mindful Eating Pace Planner
tools.description: Builds a neutral meal pacing timeline with pause points from meal length and bite intervals entered by the user.
tools.limitations: It does not prescribe portions, calories, or eating behavior; adapt to culture, access, medical needs, and comfort.

tools.title: Posture Check-In Scorer
tools.description: Summarizes yes/no self-checks for screen height, supported feet, relaxed shoulders, and position changes.
tools.limitations: A checklist score cannot evaluate posture or pain clinically; use comfort and seek qualified help for persistent symptoms.

tools.title: Session Recovery-Load Estimator
tools.description: Applies a transparent duration-times-effort calculation to compare manually logged sessions without claiming physiological precision.
tools.limitations: This simple index is not a validated readiness, fatigue, or injury measure; do not use it to override symptoms.

tools.title: Sleep Schedule Difference Estimator
tools.description: Adds up the difference between a chosen sleep target and several nights of manually entered sleep durations.
tools.limitations: This arithmetic does not measure sleep quality or establish a medical sleep problem; night-to-night estimates can be noisy.

tools.title: Morning Routine Budget
tools.description: Fits named routine blocks into a fixed morning window and reports the finish time plus any overrun.
tools.limitations: Times are approximate and do not prescribe what a morning should contain; adapt to real constraints and wellbeing.

tools.title: Personal Wellbeing Scorecard
tools.description: Combines five self-rated dimensions into a balanced snapshot and identifies the lowest-rated area for reflection.
tools.limitations: Self-ratings are subjective and this is not a screening, diagnosis, or treatment recommendation.

tools.title: Bodyweight Circuit Planner
tools.description: Generates a compact circuit structure from exercise slots, work and rest durations, and rounds, without prescribing specific movements.
tools.limitations: Use movements appropriate to your ability and space; this is structure-only and not individualized coaching.
